decisions.reason: No negative results yet, so the option remains worth keeping open at low cost.
Uncertainty is still unresolved and the product has not shown it should be abandoned.
Keeping it open preserves flexibility until more market feedback is available.
With no adverse signals, the low cost of keeping it on the market argues for continuation.
The product is part of the firm's established offer and still has option value.
An early-stage product without negative evidence should be kept as an open option.
